title: Rioproperty footer
description: A deep indigo footer band: a big yellow capital e-mail address with an arrow across the right two thirds, under it lavender capital columns (phone and address, page links, a social link with a square badge), and at the bottom left a very wide-tracked white wordmark with a capital tagline. It is revealed from under the page: the content settles down 158px and brightens as the footer scrolls in. On hover the e-mail rolls up to an identical copy and the arrow flies out up-right as a twin comes in.
notes: uses secondary as the band, accent for the links and highlight for the e-mail: best where secondary is dark
the wordmark is plain text in the display face, letter-spaced 0.35em
